name: Amalek
overview: The name Amalek appears in Scripture primarily as a son of Eliphaz, Esau's son, highlighting a specific genealogical line within Esau's descendants (Genesis 36:12; 1 Chronicles 1:36). Although the Amalekites are known as a hostile people in biblical history, the Amalek mentioned here is probably not the ancestor of the Amalekite nation encountered during Abraham's time, as indicated by the distinction in the texts (Genesis 14:7). These verses emphasize the particular family lineage of Amalek without directly connecting him to the broader Amalekite identity that later opposed Israel.
